title: Security GRC Analyst, Mergers & Acquisitions
description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are looking for a Security GRC Lead to own security governance, risk, and compliance across Payward's acquisitions. You will be the accountable owner for bringing each acquired company from its own control environment into ours, working with the M&A Technology Team from diligence through to either full platform migration or steady-state coverage under our central program.

Payward acquires and integrates companies continuously, across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory regimes. Every target arrives with its own controls, its own maturity level and its own audit history, and every one enters our financial statement audit scope on a timeline set by the deal rather than by readiness. Today that work competes for the same people who run controls for the parent company. This role exists so that it has a dedicated owner.

This is a build role to uphold the repeatable process for assessing an acquired company against our security baseline, mapping its controls into our compliance frameworks,and setting remediation milestones a newly acquired team can realistically hit. You will then run it, deal after deal, and you are accountable for the work getting done.

 

The opportunity

  • Assess each acquisition target against Payward's security baseline, during diligence where deal timelines allow and immediately post-close otherwise

  • Map the acquired company's existing controls to Payward's control framework, and identify gaps against the external frameworks the entity falls under once in scope

  • Score control maturity at the entity level and document the basis for each score

  • Define remediation milestones that are achievable for the acquired team's size and maturity, sequenced by risk reduction rather than by framework order

  • Track milestones to closure and report status to Security GRC leadership and the M&A Technology Team

  • Recommend the endpoint for each entity: full migration onto Payward platforms, or uplift to a maturity level the central program can absorb

  • Load acquired-entity risks into the enterprise risk register and keep them current

  • Prepare acquired entities for inclusion in external audit scope, including evidence collection and walkthrough support

  • Act as the Security GRC point of contact for acquired-entity leadership, finance, and internal audit

  • Maintain policy coverage for acquired entities, including building entity-specific policy libraries where the parent policy set does not apply cleanly

  • Feed recurring findings back into the diligence process, so later deals are assessed against known patterns

  • Document the onboarding process so that it is repeatable and not dependent on one person

 

What Will you Do

  • Target Assessment

    • Review target security posture during diligence: control environment, identity and access management, infrastructure, third-party dependencies, and prior audit or examination history

    • Produce a written assessment of each target against the Payward security baseline, separating the risks that matter to the deal from those that matter to steady-state operations

    • Give the M&A Technology Team and deal sponsors a clear read on what integration will cost in control remediation terms

  • Control Mapping and Framework Onboarding

    • Map acquired controls to Payward's framework and to the external frameworks the entity becomes subject to

    • Identify which parent-company controls extend to the entity as they are, which need an entity-specific variant, and which have no equivalent at all

    • Build the entity's policy library where the parent policy set does not cover it

  • Remediation and Milestones

    • Set milestones the acquired team can meet, each with a date, an owner, and a stated risk reduction

    • Sequence work so that the highest-risk gaps close first rather than the easiest ones

    • Run the cadence for tracking remediation and escalating overdue or material risks Prepare proposed risk acceptances, including the rationale and compensating controls, and present them to leadership for decision

  • Program Integration

    • Prepare entities for external audit inclusion and support fieldwork

    • Keep acquired-entity risk visible in the enterprise risk register and in Security GRC reporting

    • Hand each entity over to central GRC coverage once its maturity supports it, with the handover documented

    • Integrate 3rd parties and vendors into Payward

What you bring

  • 5-7+ years in security governance, IT risk, or compliance, including regulated financial services, fintech, or virtual asset environments

  • Direct experience onboarding an acquired company into an existing controls or compliance program. This is the core of the role

  • Working knowledge of SOX/ICFR IT general controls and what external auditors accept as evidence

  • Experience with at least two of ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, and PCI DSS, including mapping controls across frameworks

  • Ability to assess control maturity and set remediation plans the receiving team completes, including teams below Payward's maturity level

  • Hands-on delivery: you write the scope, collect the evidence, and close gaps yourself when needed

  • Sound judgment on priorities with incomplete information, and the sense to escalate decisions that need leadership

  • Ability to build working relationships with control owners in IAM, infrastructure, and engineering

  • Ability to translate control gaps into risk language that deal teams and executives can act on

  • Strong project management across cross-functional, distributed teams

  • Preferred

    • CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer

    • M&A or post-merger technology integration experience

    • Familiarity with PKM

 

Why This Role

  • You will own a domain end to end rather than supporting someone else's. There is no incumbent process and no one else doing this work today

  • Acquisitions are one of the fastest-moving parts of the business, and security integration sits on the critical path for each one

  • You will work directly with deal teams, acquired-company leadership, external auditors, and Security GRC leadership, with visibility into how acquisitions are evaluated and closed

  • Payward is preparing for public company reporting, which means the controls you put in place at acquired entities are the ones external auditors will test

  • The scope of this role grows with the acquisition pipeline, across jurisdictions and regulatory regimes

  • You will join a remote-first, international team

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

The Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic core of our product. You'll work closely with our CTO and own LLM-based features and agentic workflows end to end, from the agent framework through to the tooling that connects it to a customer's ERP. You’ll ship the cutting edge models and paradigms to Fortune 500 procurement teams.

Procurement is a demanding domain for agents: long-running workflows over messy data, where a wrong answer costs a customer real money. You'll decide how multi-agent collaboration works here, and how we benchmark it for performance, safety and behaviour.

We're building next-generation agentic systems that can manage entire procurement workflows, with a mission to make global manufacturing supply chains more resilient to an ever-changing world. That's a $3tn market opportunity.

We're backed by world-class investors including Sequoia Capital, and you'll be joining a team bringing together experience from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey.

What You’ll Do

  • Own development and deployment of LLM-based features and agentic workflows end-to-end

  • Develop new agentic frameworks to handle multi-agent collaboration.

  • Benchmark LLMs across performance, safety and behavioural monitoring.

  • Operationalise AI features by building tools to connect them to customer systems

  • Collaborate with customers and internal teams to understand customer problems and design optimal solutions

You Might Be a Great Fit if You

  • Have engineering experience at tech and product-driven companies, so you know what great code looks like

  • Have experience shipping LLM-based solutions to production

  • Have a deep understanding of the core technology behind language models, as well as computer science fundamentals

  • Have built features end-to-end in Python

  • Enjoy communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Compensation and Benefits

At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:

  • Competitive Equity: play a real part in Magentic’s upside

  • A salary of £90,000 - £110,000 per annum

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • 25 days holiday exc bank holidays, plus an extra day for our Christmas shutdown

  • In-office lunches provided

  • Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes

  • Hybrid London HQ (3 days per week, with flex if you have appointments etc)

  • Annual team retreat—a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build

Our Interview Process

We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.

  1. Initial call (30 mins): this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role.

  2. Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A.

  3. In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers.

 

Magentic is committed to creating a truly inclusive team and we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. As we grow, we're intentional about building teams with a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints, recognising that this leads to better ideas, stronger collaboration and better outcomes for our customers therefore we strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds and cultures to apply.

 

We recognise that some groups remain underrepresented within the industry and are committed to creating an environment that celebrates and supports everyone.

 

Everyone works differently, and we want to ensure our interview process gives you the best chance to show us what you can do. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let us know and we'll work with you to make the process accessible.

 

Responsible AI Statement
At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (Platform) - remote friendly
description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 

Location: You can apply to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.

Join us as a Site Reliability Engineer on our Platform SRE team and help keep Qonto fast, reliable and cost-efficient for the businesses that run their finances on it. You'll build and run the infrastructure our product engineers rely on to ship and operate their own services, under the guidance of Matthew, our Lead Platform SRE.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Be the first call for engineers: You'll take your turn on duty, answering product engineers' questions in our SRE Help Desk before getting back to your own deliverables.

  • Own a domain you care about: You'll grow into an area such as scaling Kubernetes, observability or engineer enablement, and make it yours.

  • Level up our microservices architecture: You'll help service teams run their services the same way through our Service Maturity Model initiative.

  • Cut costs through automation: You'll write software that scales our resources up and down with customer demand.

  • Lay the foundations for our AI software factory: You'll build the infrastructure that lets Qonto's engineers develop with AI at scale.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Collaboration first: You enjoy helping other engineers and teams, even when the question falls outside your own domain.

  • Sharp debugging: You've tracked down hard production problems and can explain how you found the cause.

  • Solid infrastructure foundations: You've run production workloads on a cloud platform (AWS ideally, GCP also welcome) in a mid-size or large company.

  • Comfort with regulation: You've worked where compliance matters, in finance or healthcare for example, and see process as part of the job.

  • AI-native workflow: You use AI tools in your daily work and are curious about what they can do for infrastructure and incidents.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A seat at the core of our AI strategy: Your team builds the foundational layer Qonto's AI software factory will run on.

  • Scale with real stakes: You'll help Qonto grow to more customers while holding reliability and cost steady, a line few resumes can carry.

  • A big thing of your own: Every SRE owns a major project in a domain they pick, backed by three experienced tech leads.

  • Hard problems ahead: You'll work on topics like our move from a single region towards multi-region.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Matthew, Lead Platform SRE. He leads by serving: he looks for people who love to help, gives each engineer a big thing to own, and values how you work with others as much as your technical depth.

➡️ Our stack & practices

  • Cloud: AWS, currently in a single region as we explore multi-region.

  • Application platform: Kubernetes is our core platform for hosting applications.

  • Data: Postgres for storage and ClickHouse for data collection, with growing usage.

  • Engineering workflow: GitHub for all our code and orchestration.

  • AI in infrastructure: We experiment with AI to detect and debug incidents and to manage our response.

➡️ Our methodology

  • We value upfront technical design, team code reviews, and smart slicing — quality drives the velocity our customers need.

  • Our lean toolbox, Kaizen and PDCA, lets you drive continuous improvement with your peers and manager.

Want to go further? Read about the Qonto Way.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

title: Strategy & Operations Coach APAC
description:
About The Role

We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field.

We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.

As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

Your routine responsibilities will include:

We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. title: (Junior-) Vertriebsmitarbeiter KI-Lösungen (m/w/d)
description:
Du findest KI spannend, aber noch spannender, was Unternehmen damit im Alltag wirklich anfangen können? Du redest gern mit Menschen, erkennst schnell, wo in einem Betrieb Zeit liegen bleibt, und willst einen Kunden vom ersten Anruf bis zur Unterschrift selbst begleiten? Dann passt du zu uns.

Ob Berufseinsteiger oder erfahrener Vertriebler: Wichtiger als die Zahl deiner Berufsjahre ist uns, dass du neugierig bist, zuhörst und ehrlich berätst. Du musst kein Entwickler sein. Wie unsere Plattform funktioniert, lernst du bei uns, mit den Leuten, die sie gebaut haben.

Wir sind MintCode Solutions aus Haselünne, ein Team aus 8 Leuten. Neben klassischer IT-Infrastruktur haben wir Nexus entwickelt: eine KI-Plattform, die komplett auf lokaler Hardware beim Kunden läuft. Nexus ersetzt kein ERP und keine andere Software, sondern dockt an die vorhandenen Systeme an. Betriebe automatisieren damit ihre eigenen Abläufe, von der Belegerfassung aus E-Mails über die Angebotserstellung bis zur Wissensdatenbank.

Aufgaben

  • Du erschließt dein eigenes Kundengebiet für Nexus und bist dafür verantwortlich.

  • Du betreust deine Kunden vollständig selbst, von der Kaltakquise bis zur finalen Unterschrift: Es gibt keine Übergabe an einen anderen Vertriebler

  • Du baust den Vertrieb für unsere KI-Plattform mit auf

  • Du planst selbst, welche Unternehmen du in deinem Gebiet ansprichst, und gehst aktiv auf sie zu, per Telefon, über LinkedIn, auf Veranstaltungen und über dein Netzwerk

  • Du führst Erstgespräche und findest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden heraus, welche Abläufe sich für KI eignen und welche nicht

  • Du zeigst Nexus in Demos, online und vor Ort, und erklärst es so, dass auch Nicht-Techniker den Nutzen verstehen

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Technikern die passende Lösung und erstellst das Angebot

  • Du fasst nach, verhandelst und holst die Unterschrift

  • Du bleibst auch nach dem Start der Ansprechpartner deiner Kunden, erkennst, wo Nexus ihnen noch Arbeit abnehmen kann, und baust dein Gebiet Schritt für Schritt aus

  • Du pflegst deine Kontakte und Gespräche so, dass jeder im Team den Stand nachvollziehen kann

  • Du bringst zurück ins Team, was Kunden fragen und brauchen, und redest bei der Weiterentwicklung von Nexus mit

Nexus ist bei Kunden bereits im Einsatz, der Vertrieb dafür steht aber noch am Anfang. Du hast entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Und du stehst nicht allein da: Bei technischen Fragen ist immer ein Kollege da, der mit in den Termin kommt oder mit dir draufschaut.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder vergleichbare Praxis, Quereinsteiger sind willkommen

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbst und hast Lust, dich tief in das Thema einzuarbeiten

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und telefonierst gern, auch mit Leuten, die dich noch nicht kennen

  • Du hörst zu, fragst nach und verstehst schnell, wie ein Betrieb arbeitet

  • Du erklärst Neues so, dass es beim Gegenüber ankommt, ohne Buzzwords

  • Du bleibst dran, auch wenn es beim ersten und zweiten Anruf noch kein Ja gibt

  • Du führst Gespräche zu einem Ergebnis und scheust dich nicht, nach dem Auftrag zu fragen

  • Du sagst offen, was du denkst, auch gegenüber Kunden, wenn KI für ein Problem nicht die richtige Lösung ist

  • Führerschein Klasse B und Reisebereitschaft, weil du regelmäßig bei Kunden vor Ort bist

Schön, wenn du das schon kannst (sonst lernst du es bei uns)

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Software oder erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten

  • Erfahrung mit Angeboten, Verhandlungen und Abschlüssen

  • Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse, zum Beispiel aus Buchhaltung, Einkauf, Vertrieb oder Produktion

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen aus Anwender- oder Beratersicht

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System

Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Potenzial mehr als ein perfekter Lebenslauf. Wichtig ist, dass du ehrlich berätst und Lust hast, besser zu werden.

Benefits

Ein Produkt, das du zeigen kannst. Nexus läuft bereits bei Kunden. Du verkaufst keine Folien, sondern etwas, das du live vorführen kannst.

Möglichkeit auf einen eigenen Firmenwagen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, einen eigenen Firmenwagen zu bekommen. So bist du für Kundentermine flexibel unterwegs und musst dir um dein eigenes Auto keine Gedanken machen.

Nah an der Entwicklung. Die Leute, die Nexus gebaut haben, sitzen im selben Büro. Was du vom Kunden mitbringst, fließt direkt ins Produkt ein.

Moderne Tooling-Kultur. KI-gestütztes Arbeiten für Recherche, Angebote und Vorbereitung statt Zettelwirtschaft.

Wellpass oder Streaming-Abo. Sport in tausenden Studios deutschlandweit oder Spotify bzw. Netflix auf uns. Such dir aus, was zu dir passt.

Bildungsurlaub ist willkommen. Kein unangenehmes Gespräch, kein schlechtes Gewissen. Wer sich weiterbilden will, hat unsere volle Unterstützung.

Start-up-Flair. Kurze Entscheidungswege, echte Eigenverantwortung und eine Atmosphäre, in der Ideen mehr zählen als Hierarchien.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten. Leben und Arbeit muss man manchmal jonglieren. Dafür hast du bei uns Verständnis und Spielraum.

Das sehen wir als Standard an

  • Ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • 38-Stunden-Woche

Wenn du ein KI-Produkt verkaufen willst, das bei Kunden wirklich im Einsatz ist, dann bewirb dich bei uns!

title: Marketing & Content Intern (m/w/d) - Pflichtpraktikum, Remote
description:
About Maramio

Maramio is the managed-service platform for corporate gifting and branded merch. We handle sourcing, EU warehousing, fulfillment and gifting software for European mid-market and enterprise companies. One platform and one team replace the vendors, spreadsheets and shipping headaches. Grammarly, Criteo, H&M and Adjust already work with us.

The internship

We're a small team, and marketing is where we need an extra pair of hands and a fresh pair of eyes. You'll write, design, publish and measure, across LinkedIn, our newsletter, blog and website. One week you'll turn a client project into a case study, the next you'll plan a month of posts or test a new channel. With AI tools you'll ship in a day what used to take a week, and you'll see exactly what works because we track it.

What you'll do

  • LinkedIn: draft and schedule posts for the company page and the founders, and engage with our community

  • Newsletter: help put together our monthly HubSpot newsletter and grow the list

  • Case studies & blog: interview the team, turn client projects into stories, and write SEO-friendly articles

  • Visuals: create simple graphics, product mockups and carousels in Canva

  • Website & SEO: update pages, collections and product texts, and find keyword opportunities

  • Guerrilla marketing: find communities, forums, partners and PR opportunities where our buyers hang out

  • Reporting: track what worked and suggest what to do next

  • AI workflows: use Claude, Claude Code and our ready-made prompts to research, draft and repurpose content

You'll fit in if you

  • Love writing and have a good eye for what looks right

  • Want to learn how B2B marketing works in practice, from idea to measurable result

  • Like using AI at work. Claude experience is a bonus; if you don't have it, we'll teach you

  • Are organised and figure out new tools on your own (Canva, HubSpot, LinkedIn)

  • Speak and write fluent English (must). German is a plus

  • Are enrolled at a German university, and this internship is a mandatory part of your studies (Pflichtpraktikum). We'll handle the internship agreement and your university paperwork

What you'll get

  • Real portfolio pieces: published posts, case studies, articles and campaigns with your name on them

  • Hands-on training in AI-assisted marketing workflows

  • Direct work with the founders: real responsibility, fast feedback, no busywork

  • A reference letter and a certificate for your university

  • A path to a paid role for strong performers

Format

  • Remote from Germany, flexible hours within CET

  • Unpaid mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum), with a written internship agreement, learning goals and a named supervisor

  • 20–40 hours per week, depending on your study regulations; 3–6 months; start ASAP

Not for you if

  • You'd rather avoid AI tools and do everything by hand

  • You need a fixed, fully documented routine from day one. We're small, and you'll help shape the process

title: Werkstudent (M/W/D) Ki-Entwicklung & Open Source
description:
Über die sera Gruppe

Bei sera bewegen wir mehr – gemeinsam. Als international tätige, mittelständische Unternehmensgruppe mit über 300 Kolleginnen und Kollegen an sieben Gesellschaften entwickeln wir technische Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Anwendungen. Dabei verbinden wir mittelständische Stärke mit der Dynamik eines internationalen Umfelds. Du kannst dich aktiv einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und mitgestalten. Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, kurze Entscheidungswege und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe prägen dabei unseren Arbeitsalltag.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Unterstütze sera bei der spannenden Aufgabe, eine interne Open-Source-KI-Lösung weiterzuentwickeln und für den praktischen Einsatz im Unternehmen auszubauen.

  • Du beschäftigst dich damit, wie moderne KI-Modelle und -Werkzeuge sicher und sinnvoll mit unseren internen Daten und Systemen verbunden werden können.

  • Du setzt neue Funktionen und Anwendungsmöglichkeiten um und unterstützt dabei, bestehende Komponenten technisch weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Gemeinsam testen wir unterschiedliche Ansätze, Modelle und Technologien und bewerten, welche davon sich für konkrete Anforderungen bei sera eignen.

  • Du arbeitest an prototypischen KI-Anwendungen und hilfst dabei, erfolgreiche Ansätze schrittweise in eine produktiv nutzbare Lösung zu überführen.

  • Dabei erhältst du Einblicke in Themen wie Large Language Models, RAG, APIs, lokale KI-Modelle und Open-Source-KI-Technologien.

  • Bei allen Tätigkeiten leitet dich ein erfahrener Supervisor. Hürden, die auf dem Weg aufkommen, lösen wir sera-typisch im Team.

Dein Profil

Als Student der Informatik oder eines IT-nahen Studiengangs (Bachelor oder Master) hast du die Möglichkeit, dein theoretisches Wissen praxisnah einzusetzen und zu erweitern. Am Standort Immenhausen unterstützt du sera bei spannenden Aufgaben rund um die Entwicklung und den Einsatz von KI im Unternehmenskontext.

Du musst kein KI-Experte sein. Grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse und Interesse an Softwareentwicklung solltest du jedoch mitbringen. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Python, APIs, Large Language Models oder Open-Source-Projekten sind von Vorteil.

Vor allem besitzt du die Motivation und Neugier, dich in dieses spannende Feld einzuarbeiten und gemeinsam mit uns eine echte KI-Lösung weiterzuentwickeln. Alles, was du über unsere Produkte, Systeme und Abläufe wissen musst, bekommst du in deiner Einarbeitung von unseren erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen gezeigt.

Ab sofort kannst du bei uns im Rahmen einer Werkstudententätigkeit mit 20 Stunden pro Woche Praxiserfahrung sammeln und gemeinsam mit uns Erfolge schaffen.

Die Position wird mit einem Stundenlohn von EUR 15,50 brutto für Bachelorstudenten und EUR 17,50 brutto für Masterstudenten vergütet.

WIR BIETEN DIR

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche, verantwortungsvolle Position in einem dynamischen, zukunfts- und werteorientierten, internationalen Unternehmen

  • Technische Produkte, mit denen du Kunden begeistern und helfen kannst

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents – denn wer Erfolge schafft, sollte diese auch gemeinsam feier

  • Freiraum, um eigene Ideen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen

Wir freuen uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Angabe Deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatums.

title: Trainee Redaktion YouTube (all genders)
company: Miss Germany Studios GmbH & Co. KG
description:
Miss Germany ist kein Schönheitswettbewerb, sondern eine Plattform für Frauen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas bewegen wollen. Auf YouTube entwickeln wir eigene Formate, die Frauen zwischen 16 und 35 ansprechen – nicht nur mit den Geschichten und Perspektiven unserer Kandidatinnen, sondern mit allen Themen, die diese Generation bewegen.

Gute Formate stehen und fallen mit der Vorbereitung. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der gründlich recherchiert, Zusammenhänge schnell versteht und aus Fakten, Stimmen und Hintergründen eine Grundlage baut, mit der wir vor der Kamera überzeugen.

Als Trainee Redaktion YouTube bei Miss Germany Studios bereitest du unsere eigenen Formate inhaltlich vor – von der Themenidee über die Recherche bis zum festen Briefing für Dreh und Moderation. Dabei lernst du redaktionelles Arbeiten von Grund auf in der Praxis und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.

Was du bei uns machst:

  • Recherche: Du recherchierst Themen, Fakten, Studien und Hintergründe – gründlich, schnell und mit sauberen Quellen.

  • Themenfindung: Du behältst im Blick, was gerade diskutiert wird, und schlägst Themen und Gäst:innen für unsere Formate vor.

  • Briefings: Du bereitest deine Recherche so auf, dass Moderation und Team direkt damit arbeiten können: Fragen, Thesen, Argumente und Fakten.

  • Casting & Gäste: Du findest passende Gäst:innen und Protagonist:innen, nimmst Kontakt auf, führst Vorgespräche und bereitest sie inhaltlich auf den Dreh vor.

  • Faktencheck: Du prüfst Inhalte vor der Veröffentlichung auf Richtigkeit.

Wir haben ein Match, wenn Folgendes auf dich zutrifft:

  • Du bist neugierig. Du gibst dich nicht mit der ersten Antwort zufrieden, sondern gräbst weiter.

  • Du liebst Youtube. Du bist selbst gerne auf der Plattform unterwegs und konsumierst regelmäßig Formate.

  • Du recherchierst sauber. Du erkennst seriöse Quellen und weißt, wie man Fakten prüft.

  • Du bringst Dinge auf den Punkt. Aus viel Material machst du ein klares, kurzes Briefing.

  • Du bist hands-on und kommunikativ. Du greifst auch mal zum Telefon und hast keine Scheu vor Gesprächen. Erfahrung im Casting ist ein Plus.

  • Du verstehst YouTube. Du weißt, was ein Thema spannend macht und warum Menschen bis zum Ende dranbleiben.

  • Du übernimmst Ownership. Du hältst Deadlines, denkst mit und gehst einen Schritt weiter, statt auf Antworten zu warten.

  • Du willst durchstarten. Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung abgeschlossen – idealerweise in Journalismus, Medien, Kommunikation oder Sozialwissenschaften – oder bringst vergleichbare Erfahrung mit, z. B. aus Redaktion, Podcast oder eigenen Kanälen. Ab dem 15. Januar 2027 bist du mit 40 Stunden pro Woche dabei.

Du möchtest etwas aufbauen. Nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten.

Was wir bieten:

  • Build Something Big: 2027 wird Miss Germany 100 Jahre alt. Du gestaltest die Inhalte unserer YouTube-Formate in genau dieser Phase aktiv mit.

  • Impact Driven: Wir unterstützen mit Herzblut Frauen bei ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und tragen zu einer vielfältigeren und gleichberechtigteren Gesellschaft bei.

  • Raum für Ideen: Deine Themen und Formatideen landen nicht in der Schublade, sondern im nächsten Video.

  • Ownership statt Micromanagement: Viel Vertrauen, kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Verantwortung statt endloser Abstimmungsschleifen.

  • Base Köln: Du arbeitest von Köln aus – remote oder im Co-Working-Space. Ein festes Muster gibt es nicht, wir schauen gemeinsam, was passt. Für dein Onboarding sowie regelmäßige Team- und Produktionstage kommst du nach Oldenburg in unser Head Office.

  • Work with Inspiring People: Du arbeitest mit beeindruckenden Frauen, spannenden Persönlichkeiten, Partnern und einem Netzwerk, das weit über Miss Germany hinausgeht.

  • Learn Fast: Recherche, Redaktion, Storytelling, YouTube, Personal Brands und Medien – du wirst in kurzer Zeit unglaublich viel lernen.

  • Top Gear: Neueste Hardware (Apple) und moderne Tools für deine tägliche Arbeit.

  • Team Fun: Regelmäßige Team-Events und gemeinsame Erlebnisse – zuletzt waren wir Fallschirm springen.

description:

Wir erzählen ihre Geschichten, Persönlichkeiten und Momente dort, wo sie gesehen werden: auf YouTube Shorts, Instagram und TikTok.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Short-Form nicht nur schaut, sondern versteht. Jemanden, der in den ersten zwei Sekunden eine Hook setzt, im Rhythmus schneidet und weiß, warum ein Reel durch die Decke geht – und ein anderes nicht.

Als Trainee Content Creation bei Miss Germany Studios schneidest du Short-Form-Content aus unserer YouTube-Serie und Produktionen – und aus Ideen, die du selbst mitbringst. Und wenn es passt, stehst du auch mal selbst vor der Kamera. Dabei lernst du Short-Form von Grund auf in der Praxis und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.

Was du bei uns machst:

Schnitt: Du schneidest Shorts, Reels und TikToks – schnell, plattformgerecht und mit starken Hooks. Aus langen YouTube-Folgen, Event-Material und Behind-the-Scenes machst du Clips, die für sich allein funktionieren.

Trends & Formate: Du weißt, was auf den Plattformen gerade läuft, und bringst eigene Formatideen ein.

Vor der Kamera: Du drehst (dich) auch mal selbst.

Learnings: Du schaust dir an, was performt, und lässt das in die nächsten Videos einfließen.

Wir haben ein Match, wenn Folgendes auf dich zutrifft:

Du lebst Short-Form. Du scrollst nicht einfach – du analysierst ganz automatisch, warum dich ein Video nach zwei Sekunden hat.

Du kannst schneiden. Premiere Pro oder CapCut – Hauptsache, du bist schnell und hast ein Gefühl für Timing, Pacing und Sound.

Du bringst Social-Erfahrung mit. Idealerweise hast du schon Social-Media-Kanäle betreut oder eigenen Content veröffentlicht – für ein Unternehmen, eine Agentur oder deinen eigenen Kanal.

Du hast Creator-Energie. Du wartest nicht auf Briefings, sondern kommst mit Ideen.

Kamera ist kein Problem. Du hast keine Scheu, auch mal selbst vor der Linse zu stehen – musst aber nicht.

Du übernimmst Ownership. Du hältst Deadlines, denkst mit und gehst einen Schritt weiter, statt auf Antworten zu warten.

Du willst durchstarten. Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung abgeschlossen – idealerweise in Medien, Kommunikation oder Film – oder bringst vergleichbare Erfahrung mit,
z. B. durch eigene Kanäle. Ab dem 15. Januar 2027 bist du mit 40 Stunden pro Woche dabei.

Du möchtest etwas aufbauen. Nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten.

Was wir bieten:

Build Something Big: 2027 wird Miss Germany 100 Jahre alt. Du gestaltest unseren Short-Form-Auftritt in genau dieser Phase aktiv mit.

Impact Driven: Wir unterstützen mit Herzblut Frauen bei ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und tragen zu einer vielfältigeren und gleichberechtigteren Gesellschaft bei.

Creator Playground: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, Formate auszuprobieren und gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, was Menschen wirklich bewegt.

Ownership statt Micromanagement: Viel Vertrauen, kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Verantwortung statt endloser Abstimmungsschleifen.

Base Köln/Düsseldorf: Du arbeitest von Köln oder Düsseldorf aus – remote oder im Co-Working-Space. Ein festes Muster gibt es nicht, wir schauen gemeinsam, was passt. Für dein Onboarding sowie regelmäßige Team- und Produktionstage kommst du nach Oldenburg in unser Head Office.

Work with Inspiring People: Du arbeitest mit beeindruckenden Frauen, spannenden Persönlichkeiten, Partnern und einem Netzwerk, das weit über Miss Germany hinausgeht.

Learn Fast: Schnitt, Storytelling, Plattformen, Community, Personal Brands und Medien – du wirst in kurzer Zeit unglaublich viel lernen.

Top Gear: Neueste Hardware (Apple) und moderne Tools für deine tägliche Arbeit.

Team Fun: Regelmäßige Team-Events und gemeinsame Erlebnisse – zuletzt waren wir Fallschirm springen.

Sharing is caring – mit unserem Opening-Bonus, wächst mit Ruby auch dein Konto Egal, wie du zur Arbeit kommst – einen Mobility-Zuschuss gibt's on top Take it to the next level – sichere dir extra Cash durch Talent Scouting, halbjährliche Sonderzahlungen und eine individuelle Bonusvereinbarung Level up your game – mit Trainings, Coaching und Mentoring hast du die Chance, genau so sehr über dich hinauszuwachsen, wie auch Ruby wächst Innovation ist Teil unserer DNA – Lean Luxury, paperless, cashless, … you name it

Egal, ob du einen Blick fürs Detail hast oder mit deiner kreativen und innovativen Art neue Wege gehen willst, ob du technikaffin bist oder doch eher Zahlen deine Leidenschaft sind - bei Ruby findest sicherlich auch du bald deinen Platz. Wir suchen ständig außergewöhnliche Charaktere und leidenschaftliche Team Player.

title: Datacentre Operations Engineer
description:
About Us

Radiant is powered intelligence, delivering scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure purpose-built for AI and HPC workloads. Operating across global data centres, we run mission-critical environments where uptime, throughput, and ultra-low latency are non-negotiable.

Role Overview

We are seeking a deeply technical, hardware-passionate Datacentre Operations Engineer to execute on-the-ground operations for our new East London deployment—Radiant's newest AI infrastructure site. This role focuses on delivering precise, repeatable physical practices—including advanced smart-hands support, complex cabling, and hands-on operation of high-density, air-cooled compute systems—to guarantee world-class SLAs on next-generation hardware architecture.

Working closely with Infrastructure (HPC) SRE, Network Engineering, and Datacentre Strategy teams, you will uphold uncompromising standards across East London's data centre floor, spanning multiple data halls. You will live and breathe the hardware, maintaining elite facility reliability through hands-on deployment, proactive maintenance, rapid incident response, and structured break/fix execution across high-density air cooling systems, busbar-based power distribution, and next-generation GPU compute platforms. The role centres on technical execution and optimised output.

You will turn global engineering standards into flawless, repeatable daily routines, continually honing on-the-ground practices to keep our most advanced hardware running at peak performance. East London's hardware platform is NVIDIA B300-class, fully air-cooled compute, delivered through a new OEM partner being onboarded to Radiant's fleet; while the interfaces and overall architecture closely align with other OEM platforms you may already know, you'll be one of the first teams operating it on the ground, so a fast learning curve and strong first-principles troubleshooting matter more than prior exposure to this specific vendor.

You will be part of the founding team standing up 24x7x365 on-site coverage at East London to meet tight customer SLAs, and as Radiant expands its EMEA footprint, your relentless drive for hardware perfection and proven field expertise with high-density environments will serve as the operational blueprint to scale execution models efficiently across the region.

What’s in it for you?

Join a team operating some of the world’s most advanced high-performance computing infrastructure. As a Datacentre Operations Engineer, you’ll work hands-on with cutting-edge GPU and CPU platforms — including the latest NVIDIA architectures — powering dense, large-scale compute environments used for AI, machine learning, and next-generation workloads.

This is an opportunity to build expertise at the forefront of modern infrastructure, where reliability, scale, and performance matter every day. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers across a globally distributed organisation that values openness, inclusion, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

We move quickly, solve meaningful challenges, and give people the space to make an impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with advanced technology, and want to help shape the future of high-performance compute, you’ll find both challenge and opportunity here.

You can also expect:

  • Exposure to industry-leading GPU and AI infrastructure

  • Opportunities to grow alongside a rapidly scaling global business

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and supportive engineering culture

  • Real ownership and the ability to influence operational excellence

  • Work that sits at the intersection of people, performance, and technology

  • A modern, flexible, globally connected workplace with ambitious goals

Key Responsibilities

Hardware Operations & Break/Fix

  • Quickly diagnose and resolve hardware and network issues to maximise uptime; execute structured fault isolation methodologies to drive rapid resolution

  • Respond to critical hardware alerts via our monitoring and observability platform; contribute to ongoing service improvement to improve monitoring capability and alert quality

  • Deploy and maintain HPC and AI hardware for uninterrupted operations, including hardware troubleshooting, firmware updates, and component replacement

  • Execute break/fix procedures for advanced hardware platforms, including GPU module exchange, component-level fault isolation, and firmware-level diagnostics

  • Execute or support break/fix operations on ultra-high-density compute systems including NVIDIA B300-class chassis or equivalent platforms, including GPU/fan module exchange, chassis-level fault isolation, and busbar connection/disconnection—under the direction of the Lead where qualification is in progress

Air Cooling Operations

  • Operate, monitor, and maintain high-density air cooling infrastructure in conjunction with our datacentre partner, including CRAC/CRAH units, in-row and containment cooling, and associated airflow management systems

  • Facilitate in conjunction with our datacentre partner, routine and corrective maintenance on air cooling systems: monitoring supply/return temperatures and airflow rates, maintaining hot-aisle/cold-aisle containment and blanking, and performing scheduled filter and component inspections

  • Follow and contribute to SOPs for safe working around high-density, air-cooled compute platforms

  • Monitor thermal performance and raise anomalies before they escalate into incidents

Capacity Management

  • Contribute to site-level capacity management operations, maintaining accurate records of power, space, and cooling utilisation

  • Support capacity planning activities by providing accurate as-built data and flagging infrastructure changes to the Lead and relevant teams

  • Manage on-the-ground assets from point of purchase and delivery through lifecycle management and disposal, owning asset management within Radiant's CMDB system

Infrastructure & Facilities

  • Handle RMAs and support requests within Radiant's Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to meet customer contract SLAs

  • Contribute to ongoing maintenance, fostering compliance and leveraging strong vendor partnerships

  • Operate cooling, power distribution (including busbar and PDU infrastructure), and other critical data centre technologies to maintain high operational standards

  • Develop and maintain datacentre/hardware management SOPs, ensuring continual alignment with Radiant's governance and compliance requirements

Service & Operational Excellence

  • Apply ITSM frameworks: Incident, Major Incident, Change Management, and service improvement

  • Operate and support services 24x7x365 for production environments as part of a structured on-site shift rotation—working 12-hour shifts across a 4-team pattern with two engineers on shift at all times—to meet tight customer SLAs

  • Prioritise and triage incident and smart-hands workload ensuring tight SLA coverage is maintained with a small on the ground team

  • Contribute to Incident postmortem analyses, root cause analysis, document learnings, and automate remediations

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly to stakeholders and customers

  • Champion a culture of: do, document, automate

  • Willing to cross train and upskill in Infrastructure/Platform SRE practices

  • Willing to travel across EMEA to support future datacentre onboarding and train in new technologies

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Degree in Computer Science/Electrical Engineering, or 5+ years of directly relevant industry experience in data centre operations

  • 3+ years of experience in data centre operations, HPC, or related roles

  • Passion for hardware and upholding the highest operational standards on the ground

  • Strong communication skills in English

  • Proven hands-on experience with HPC/NVIDIA GPU platforms or equivalent high-density compute systems, high-performance storage, and networking

  • Practical knowledge of high-density air cooling systems—CRAC/CRAH operation, airflow and thermal monitoring, containment management, and associated maintenance—or strong related cooling infrastructure experience

  • Experience with, or demonstrable willingness and aptitude to train on, ultra-high-density compute platforms such as NVIDIA B300, busbar-based power distribution, or equivalent systems

  • Experience with and passion for management of compute at massive scale

  • Comfort operating a newly-onboarded OEM hardware platform, applying transferable knowledge from other high-density GPU/HPC OEM systems to ramp up quickly without direct prior exposure to this specific vendor

  • Familiarity with structured break/fix practices for complex hardware platforms, including module-level component exchange and firmware fault isolation

  • Expertise in hardware installation, network configuration, and low-level system maintenance, including firmware management

  • Knowledge of data centre environment technologies, including cooling and high-density power distribution

  • Understanding of capacity management principles: power, space, and cooling tracking

  • Strong understanding of hardware and spares management; ability to handle RMAs within defined SLOs

  • Understanding of HPC and AI workloads at a high level

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and resilience in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong grasp of ITSM and service operation best practices

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional, internationally dispersed teams

  • Comfortable interfacing with internal stakeholders and external customers

  • Bonus: Vendor-endorsed qualifications from NVIDIA or equivalent OEMs for high-density, air-cooled AI compute systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of large scale private cloud deployments and capacity planning.

  • Qualifications in HVAC management and deployments

  • Certifications in relevant areas - Hardware, Networking

  • ITIL Foundation level qualification or equivalent experience

title: AWS AI Solution Architect
description:
AWS AI Solutions Architect

Location: London

Travel: Travel across Europe (Germany, Denmark, Netherlands, France, Spain, Switzerland)

Full time- Permanent

Role Overview

As an AWS AI Solutions Architect, you will be a key member of Europe Account and Go-To-Market teams, responsible for shaping, selling, and demonstrating modern cloud and AI-led solutions for strategic customers. This is a highly customer-facing role spanning solution architecture, RFP ownership, PoC creation, and executive-level demonstrations, with a strong emphasis on AWS AI services and modern application architectures.

This a delivery and pre-sales mix role with strong hands-on expertise.

Core skillset is Full Stack architect with React + Java Spring Boot + AWS + GENAI (AWS Bedrock, Strands SDK and Agent core).

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Pre-Sales

- Act as a trusted technical advisor, leading deep architectural discussions across cloud, data, and AI.

- Partner with sales and account teams to articulate the value of AWS and AI offerings.

- Build strong relationships with senior customer architects, engineering leaders, and CIO/CTO stakeholders.

Solution Architecture & AI Innovation

- Design end-to-end AWS solutions covering AI/ML/GenAI, cloud-native applications, data platforms, and modernization.

- Lead PoC and demo creation including GenAI, Copilot-style, and agentic AI demonstrations.

- Define scalable, secure, high-performance architectures aligned with AWS best practices.

RFPs, Proposals & GTM Assets

- Own and lead RFP responses for AWS, AI, and cloud transformation initiatives.

- Create proactive propositions and solution POVs for strategic accounts.

- Conduct customer workshops and design sessions to co-create high-impact solutions.

Alliance & Ecosystem Collaboration

- Work closely with AWS Alliance Managers and partner teams.

- Align solutions with AWS reference architectures, funding programs, and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with internal practices to accelerate customer outcomes.

Required Skills & Experience

- 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture and solution design.

- Strong hands-on expertise in AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, containers).

- Proven experience with AWS AI/ML services such as Agent Core, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Comprehend, Textract, and GenAI patterns (RAG, copilots, agents).

- Strong development experience in Java and/or Python, with frontend exposure to React or modern JavaScript frameworks.

- Experience in application modernization, cloud migration, DevSecOps, and Infrastructure as Code.

- 5+ years of customer-facing experience in consulting or pre-sales roles.

- Strong presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills.

Nice to Have

- AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect – Professional preferred).

- Experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, BFS, or Utilites.

- Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP).

- Additional European language skills.

title: Data & People analytics Intern - January 2027
description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our People team at Mirakl, a global team of around 30 people covering the full employee lifecycle across all of our offices worldwide. Together, you'll be contributing to building an exceptional employee experience and shaping the future of how Mirakl grows, learns, and develops its talent.
 

2. Your Impact

  • Coordinate learning events — Organise Manager Days, hackathons, bootcamps, lunch & learns and show-and-tell sessions, owning logistics, invitations, materials and post-event follow-up from start to finish.
  • Track participation and feedback — Manage attendance, collect feedback and synthesise key learnings and improvement opportunities to continuously raise the bar on our learning programmes.
  • Curate learning content — Audit and structure existing AI, enablement and learning resources into clear, audience-specific learning paths that make it easy for every Miraklian to grow.
  • Create practical resources — Develop guides, FAQs, checklists and quick-reference materials that support learning adoption and make knowledge accessible across the organisation.
  • Support AI fluency initiatives — Gather and document AI use cases, design surveys and knowledge checks, and organise assessment data to help the People team make informed decisions.
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's level degree in HR, from a business school or university
  • Experience in HR or learning is a plus, but not a prerequisite. Hybrid profiles combining analytical skills and project management are welcome.
  • Comfortable organising events and facilitating sessions, in connection with the projects mentioned.
  • Availability for a 6-month internship starting in January 2027 is required.
Skills:
  • Rigorous and autonomous, with strong tracking and reporting capabilities
  • Genuine interest in AI
  • Appetite for project management, data analysis and cross-functional collaboration
  • Strong communication skills in French and English
 

4. Tools Used

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Collaborative tools (e.g. Notion, Google Workspace, or equivalent)
 

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Professional proficiency (B2 minimum, C1 preferred)
 

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  1. Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month, based on your level of study.

  2. Perks & Benefits:

    • A workplace that supports well-being and balance: breakfasts, fitness and yoga classes, after-work events, game nights
    • Mentoring from senior technical experts and regular feedback to support your growth
    • Immersion in a collaborative, international team passionate about sharing knowledge
    • 2 remote work days per month
    • Access to Works Council discounts (tickets, etc.)
    • Gymlib pass for your well-being
    • Modern offices in the heart of Paris (near the Eiffel Tower)
    • Swile meal vouchers
    • Transportation covered (50% Navigo, bike, etc.)
 

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Interview with our recruiter to discuss your profile and expectations
  3. Interview with your future manager
  4. Structured interview using the STAR method to ensure transparency and fairness
  5. Welcome to Mirakl! 🎉

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie
description:
Alassio recrute son ou sa Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie !

En un coup d'œil

  • Contrat : CDI

  • Lieu : Paris ou Aix-en-Provence ; hybride

  • Équipe : Métier

  • Expérience : 2 à 5 ans en paie, avec une forte composante paramétrage

 
 

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Nous étendons en continu la couverture d'Alassio à de nouvelles conventions collectives et à de nouveaux dispositifs réglementaires. Chaque paramétrage se retrouve sur des milliers de bulletins : ta rigueur garantit la justesse des paies de nos cabinets, et ta réactivité leur permet d'obtenir vite les ajustements dont ils ont besoin.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu fais évoluer le moteur de paie d'Alassio : c'est toi qui traduis les règles de paie (conventions collectives, dispositifs réglementaires, cas particuliers) en paramétrage fiable, utilisé par tous nos cabinets. Tu travailles avec les équipes Métier et Juridique à l'extension réglementaire d'Alassio, en t'appuyant sur les workflows IA d'intégration et de mise à jour des paramètres légaux et conventionnels que nous avons développés.

 

🧭 Tes missions

  • Réaliser et maintenir le paramétrage du moteur : rubriques, cotisations, profils de paie et conventions collectives

  • Traiter les demandes de paramétrage de bout en bout : diagnostic, analyse, paramétrage et livraison, en lien avec notre équipe Juridique

  • Requalifier les cas limites : distinguer ce qui relève du moteur, du paramétrage propre au dossier du cabinet ou d'une évolution produit

  • Mettre en œuvre les évolutions réglementaires : analyser, paramétrer et tester les changements de taux, de plafonds et de règles

  • Traiter les corrections issues du support : vérifier et ajuster les modifications analysées, puis les valider et les implémenter

  • Tester chaque paramétrage livré : tests de conformité et de non-régression, construction et entretien des jeux de tests

  • Fiabiliser le workflow IA d'intégration des CCN : contrôler, tester et corriger ce qu'il produit

  • Gérer la file des demandes : prioriser, suivre et accompagner la validation des livrables

  • Documenter les paramétrages réalisés

  • Analyser des cas clients pour identifier l'origine d'un écart de calcul

  • Remonter au Product les anomalies et les besoins d'évolution du produit

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Tu travailles au quotidien avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) et Ludivine (Resp. Juridique)

  • Tu travailles également avec l'équipe Support, l'équipe Tech et l'équipe Déploiement & Accompagnement (DnA)

  • Outils : Alassio, Linear, Notion, outils d'IA développés par Alassio

 

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

  • À 1 mois : tu maîtrises le moteur de paramétrage et le workflow IA des CCN, et tes premières corrections sont validées en binôme

  • À 3 mois : tu reprends en autonomie le paramétrage quotidien, avec des jeux de tests de non-régression en place sur ton périmètre

  • À 6 mois : tu pilotes en autonomie une campagne d'évolutions réglementaires et tu tiens les délais de traitement des corrections

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

  • Formation en paie ou en RH, ou expérience équivalente

  • 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en paie avec une forte composante paramétrage : consultant(e) paramétrage ou expert(e) fonctionnel(le) chez un éditeur, gestionnaire de paie référent(e) outil, ou paramétrage SIRH

  • Pratique approfondie d'un logiciel de paie du marché

  • Aisance dans la lecture et l'interprétation des conventions collectives

  • Esprit logique et rigueur de test : tu ne valides pas un paramétrage sans l'avoir vérifié sur des cas concrets

  • Bonne connaissance de la DSN

Un plus :

  • Notions de code (Python) ou de logique de formules avancées

  • Utilisation avancée des outils d'IA

 

💎 Qualités

  • La rigueur et l'autonomie

  • La curiosité pour la tech et l'IA

  • La capacité à tenir les pics d'activité

 
 

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Appel d'introduction avec Hector (COO) : 30 min

2️⃣ Entretien métier avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) : 45 min

3️⃣ Cas pratique en direct avec Huy Anh : paramétrer une disposition conventionnelle (par exemple une prime d'ancienneté ou un maintien de salaire) et écrire les cas de test associés : 1 h

4️⃣ Rencontre avec l'équipe : 1 h

👉 Le processus se termine par des prises de référence.

 
 

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Être au cœur du moteur de paie d'un logiciel nouvelle génération, travailler avec l'IA au quotidien et voir ton travail utilisé chaque mois sur les bulletins de milliers de salariés.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 💰 Rémunération fixe de 60 à 75K€ selon l'expérience + BSPCE

  • 🏥 Mutuelle Alan

  • 🍽️ Carte Swile (titres-restaurant)

  • 💻 Matériel informatique haut de gamme (MacOS, écran incurvé)

  • 🏡 Télétravail régulier possible

  • 🤓 Offsites d'équipe réguliers (un par trimestre en moyenne)

 

Certaines personnes hésitent à postuler quand elles ne cochent pas toutes les cases. Si tu hésites, postule quand même : on en parlera volontiers.

 

➡️ Prochaines étapes

title: R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

As an R&D Facility & Safety Specialist, you will work with the Engineering Program, Safety and Operations teams to ensure the smooth and safe operation of Proxima’s Swiss industrial facilities. This is a high-ownership role requiring strong organizational and communication skills supporting structured technical thinking.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as the Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r (SiBe) or Safety Contact Person for Proxima Fusion’s Swiss subsidiary.

    • Coordinate our safety organisation and keep its documentation up to date

    • Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

    • Investigate incidents and near misses, and advise management on risks and corrective actions

    • Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

    • Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

    • Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

  • Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

  • Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

  • Manage and procure consumables and stock materials for manufacturing

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced technician, technical engineer, safety engineer, or operations specialist with experience in hardware development environments

  • At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

  • Holding SiBe/KOPAS training (SUVA or equivalent), or willing to complete it in your first three months; experienced applying health and safety practice in Switzerland or the EU

  • A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

  • A confident, self-aware communicator who collaborates well and can negotiate effectively with suppliers and external partners.

  • Fluent in German and conversational in English.

  • Holding a driving license valid in Switzerland.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Training or qualifications in industrial safety

  • Experience in warehouse management - knowledge of incoming goods best practices and experience building an in-house process.

  • Knowledge of fire safety and industrial hazards

  • Experience with cryogenic, pressure equipment, chemical and electrical hazards

  • Experience with heavy lift equipment and operations

  • First aid training

  • Qualified in Switzerland to operate overhead cranes or forklifts

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • On-site Technical Panel (3x60 min)

.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.
