description:
Content Creator & Online Marketing (20 %)


Teilzeit (20 %)

Du liebst Social Media, hast kreative Ideen, bist KI-affin und weisst, wie man mit einem spannende Inhalte produziert? Dann suchen wir genau dich!

Die Hüsser & Palkoska AG ist ein vielseitiges Automobilunternehmen mit Standorten in Baar und Neuheim. Von der klassischen Werkstatt über Elektromobilität und Fahrzeughandel bis hin zu unserer neuen Carrosserie- und Lackiererei bieten wir ein breites Spektrum rund ums Automobil.

Wir möchten unsere Geschichten, unser Fachwissen und die Menschen hinter unserem Unternehmen noch stärker sichtbar machen. Dafür suchen wir eine kreative und selbstständige Persönlichkeit, die unseren digitalen Auftritt aktiv mitgestaltet.

Bei uns musst du keine aufwendigen Filmproduktionen erstellen. Wir setzen auf authentische Inhalte, gute Ideen und eine unkomplizierte Umsetzung mit Smartphone.

Was erwartet dich?

  • Selbstständige Ideenfindung und Entwicklung spannender Inhalte rund um unseren Betrieb

  • Planung, Produktion und Veröffentlichung von Videos

  • Filmen mit dem Smartphone an unseren Standorten

  • Durchführung von kurzen Interviews mit unseren Mitarbeitenden und Fachpersonen

  • Videoschnitt inklusive Musik, Untertiteln und passenden Effekten

  • Erstellung von Blogs die GEO und SEO

  • Optimierung der Blogbeiträge für Google und KI-basierte Suchmaschinen (SEO/GEO)

  • Erstellung und Pflege eines Marketing- und Redaktionsplans

  • Regelmässige Abstimmung der Marketingplanung mit der Geschäftsleitung

  • Beobachtung aktueller Social-Media-Trends und Einbringen neuer Ideen

  • Einfache Auswertung der veröffentlichten Inhalte und ihrer Reichweite

Was wünschen wir uns von dir?

  • Freude an Social Media

  • Erfahrung mit CapCut

  • Sicherer Umgang mit dem Smartphone für Video- und Fotoaufnahmen

  • Kreativität und ein gutes Gespür für interessante Geschichten

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und grosses Interesse diese effizient einzusetzen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und Freude am Schreiben

  • Grundkenntnisse in Online-Marketing, SEO und Website-Pflege von Vorteil

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit Inhalte vorausschauend zu planen

  • Offene und kommunikative Persönlichkeit die gerne auf Menschen zugeht

  • Eigeninitiative: Du erkennst spannende Themen und setzt deine Ideen selbstständig um

  • Pragmatische Einstellung, du möchtest gute Inhalte produzieren, statt alles unnötig kompliziert zu machen

  • Wohnort vorzugsweise in der Region Zug

Wichtig zu wissen:

Ein wesentlicher Teil deiner Arbeit findet direkt in unseren Betrieben statt. Für Filmaufnahmen, Interviews und die Sammlung interessanter Geschichten bist du mindestens einen halben Tag pro Woche vor Ort.

Die Ideenfindung, Planung, Videobearbeitung und Texterstellung kannst du nach Absprache auch von zu Hause aus erledigen. Dafür verwendest du deine eigenen Geräte wie Smartphone und Laptop. An unseren Standorten stellen wir dir die notwendigen Arbeitsgeräte zur Verfügung. Für die Arbeit im Homeoffice werden keine Geräte bereitgestellt.

Eine vollständig remote ausgeführte Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was kannst du von uns erwarten?

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Teilzeitstelle

  • Viel Freiraum für eigene Ideen und kreative Umsetzungen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit klar geregelter Präsenz vor Ort

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung

  • Quantitativ klar geregelte Zielvorgaben

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und unkomplizierte Zusammenarbeit

  • Spannende Einblicke in die Automobilbranche, Elektromobilität, Werkstatt, Fahrzeughandel sowie Carrosserie und Lackiererei

  • Ein motiviertes, hilfsbereites Team mit spannenden Persönlichkeiten und Geschichten

  • Die Möglichkeit unseren digitalen Markenauftritt aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln

  • Ein modernes und vielseitiges Arbeitsumfeld

  • Attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile rund ums Automobil

  • 5 Wochen Ferien

  • Kostenloser Mitarbeiterparkplatz

Bereit, unsere Geschichten zu erzählen?

Bei uns erwartet dich kein klassischer Bürojob. Du bist mittendrin, wenn Fahrzeuge repariert, lackiert, verkauft oder spannende technische Herausforderungen gelöst werden.

Du lernst unsere Mitarbeitenden kennen, entdeckst interessante Geschichten und machst daraus Inhalte, die Menschen begeistern und unser Unternehmen bekannter machen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht auf den nächsten Auftrag wartet, sondern selbst Ideen entwickelt, mitdenkt und gerne Verantwortung übernimmt.

Du fühlst dich angesprochen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Überzeuge uns mit deiner Kreativität, deiner Persönlichkeit und deiner Motivation. Wir sind gespannt darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mehr über deine Ideen zu erfahren.

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams bei der Hüsser & Palkoska AG.

title: Enterprise Solutions Architect
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an Enterprise Solutions Architect with deep expertise in life science R&D and enterprise software systems to partner with Benchling's customers in driving the biotech revolution forward.

The Enterprise Solutions Architect serves as a strategic advisor and technical leader for our enterprise customers, translating their IT strategy into tailored Benchling solutions. This role encompasses guiding organizations through digital transformation, leading technical implementation projects, overseeing solution architecture, and establishing best practices and data architecture standards to ensure long-term success.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with biotechnology organizations at the forefront of innovation to assess their IT landscape, understand strategic objectives, and architect solutions that enable mission-critical outcomes.

  • Lead end-to-end implementation projects from discovery through successful go-live and adoption.

  • Provide ongoing strategic guidance, best practice education, and product engagement recommendations to maximize customer value realization.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and translate business needs into technical solutions in partnership with internal engineering, product, and solutions architecture teams.

  • Coordinate with Professional Services, Product, and Customer Success teams to orchestrate complex, global enterprise deployments.

  • Support Sales and Marketing in technical deal strategy, and engage with Engineering, Product, and Solutions Architecture teams to resolve complex technical challenges.

  • Contribute to the development and refinement of global enterprise processes, product capabilities, and best practice frameworks.

  • Partner with biotechnology organizations at the forefront of innovation to assess their IT landscape, understand strategic objectives, and architect solutions that enable mission-critical outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

 Required

  • 5-10+ years of combined experience in biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry roles and scientific software implementation.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Information Management, or related field (advanced degree preferred).

  • Proven track record leading global implementation teams in enterprise solution design and deployment (Benchling experience strongly preferred).

  • Demonstrated ability to empathize with scientists and rapidly comprehend complex scientific concepts and workflows.

  • Exceptional communication skills across verbal, written, and presentation formats, coupled with strong organizational and project management capabilities.

  • Self-directed, adaptable professional who thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

  • Comfortable operating across functions, organizational levels, and geographies with diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites up to 30% based on project requirements.

Preferred

  • 5+ years of client-facing software implementation and/or consulting experience, with demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale SaaS projects.

  • Hands-on experience implementing scientific/informatics platforms such as LIMS, ELN, MES, LES, and analytical tools including JMP, Spotfire, or Tableau.

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

#LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote

#BI-Hybrid #BI-Remote

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

description:
Programmatic Advertising Specialist (Dutch Speaking)

Publisher Success | Amsterdam, Netherlands (Onsite) | Full Time | Permanent

About Refinery89



Refinery89 is a Dutch AdTech company headquartered in Madrid, working with premium publishers worldwide to optimize programmatic advertising performance.

Through advanced, data-driven technology, we help publishers maximize advertising revenue, improve monetization efficiency, and gain greater transparency across their advertising operations.

Our international team brings together specialists in programmatic advertising, publisher monetization, technology, and account management to deliver measurable results for our partners.

About the Role



Are you currently working in Programmatic Advertising, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, or Publisher Monetization and looking to take the next step in your career?

We're looking for a Dutch-speaking Programmatic Advertising Specialist to join our Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with a solid understanding of digital advertising who wants to move beyond campaign execution and take on a more strategic, publisher-facing role.

You don't need previous Account Management experience. We're particularly interested in candidates who understand the programmatic advertising ecosystem, enjoy analyzing performance, solving technical challenges, and communicating with clients.

You'll work directly with Dutch publishers, helping them optimize their advertising performance, maximize revenue, and develop long-term partnerships with Refinery89.

You'll collaborate closely with our Technical Account Managers, AdTech specialists, Product, and Sales teams to deliver the best possible experience for our publishing partners.

Key Responsibilities



Publisher Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers in the Netherlands.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for publisher inquiries, performance discussions, and ongoing support.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each publisher's business needs and monetization objectives.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and problem-solving.


Programmatic Performance & Revenue Optimization

  • Monitor and analyze advertising performance, including revenue, eCPM, fill rates, and other relevant programmatic metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve publisher monetization and overall advertising performance.
  • Translate advertising data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with technical specialists to implement and evaluate optimization initiatives.


Technical Coordination & Troubleshooting

  • Help publishers identify and resolve advertising-related issues.
  • Work closely with internal AdTech and Technical Account Management teams to investigate technical challenges.
  • Coordinate solutions and ensure publishers receive timely updates.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Refinery89's advertising technology and monetization solutions.


Strategic Growth & Publisher Success

  • Identify opportunities to grow existing publisher accounts.
  • Support publisher performance reviews and strategic discussions.
  • Share insights about market trends, advertising technologies, and monetization opportunities.
  • Contribute to long-term publisher satisfaction, retention, and growth.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Publisher Sales, Technical Account Managers, AdTech, Product, and Finance teams.
  • Communicate publisher feedback and market insights internally.
  • Help improve processes, workflows, and the overall publisher experience.


What We're Looking For



Must-Have Qualifications

  • Native-level Dutch proficiency, with professional working proficiency in English.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in programmatic advertising, AdTech, digital advertising, campaign management, or publisher operations.
  • Familiarity with the programmatic advertising ecosystem, including technologies such as Google Ad Manager, SSPs, DSPs, or ad exchanges.
  • Comfortable working with advertising performance data, reports, and dashboards.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in working directly with publishers and developing long-term business relationships.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Ad Manager or other advertising platforms.
  • Knowledge of header bidding, Prebid.js, or publisher monetization strategies.
  • Previous experience working with publishers, media owners, or advertising technology companies.
  • Experience in campaign optimization, yield management, or programmatic trading.
  • Previous client-facing or Account Management experience.


Previous Account Management experience is NOT required.

Who Should Apply?



We encourage applications from professionals currently working in roles such as:

  • Programmatic Advertising Specialist
  • Programmatic Trader
  • Ad Operations Specialist
  • Campaign Manager (Programmatic)
  • Publisher Operations Specialist
  • Yield Optimization Specialist
  • Digital Advertising Specialist
  • Technical Account Specialist (AdTech)


If you have a technical understanding of digital advertising and want to develop your career in publisher relationship management, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join Refinery89?

  • Work at a growing international AdTech company with Dutch roots.
  • Develop expertise in publisher monetization and programmatic advertising.
  • Transition into a more strategic, client-facing position while building on your existing technical knowledge.
  • Collaborate with experienced AdTech professionals across multiple departments.
  • Gain exposure to premium publishers and advanced advertising technologies.
  • Build your career in a dynamic and rapidly evolving industry.


Interview Process



Our recruitment process consists of four stages:

  1. Initial Screening: Introductory call with our Talent Acquisition team.
  2. First Interview: Video interview with members of the Publisher Success team.
  3. Second Interview: Interview with the Hiring Manager and/or senior stakeholders.
  4. Final Interview: In-person meeting with the Hiring Manager and key team members (location to be confirmed).


Ready to Take the Next Step?



Whether you're currently managing advertising campaigns, optimizing programmatic performance, or supporting publisher monetization, this could be your opportunity to take on greater responsibility and develop your career in AdTech.

Apply today and join Refinery89's Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

  • Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

  • Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

  • Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

  • Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

  • Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

  • Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

  • Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

  • Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

  • Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

  • Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

  • A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

  • Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

  • Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

  • Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

  • Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Early Childhood Teacher (PT)
description:
Job Title: PreK / K Math Teacher

Job type: Part-Time - 20-30 hours/week (W-2)

Location: Remote

Intended Start Date: Training and Lesson Preparation will begin ASAP. Classes are set to start in the Fall and Winter Semester.

Who We Are:

Think Academy US (www.TheThinkAcademy.com), a 100% owned subsidiary of TAL Education Group(NYSE: TAL), is recently established education technology (Ed-Tech) company to provide K-12 extra-curricular learning services through science and technology. At Think Academy, we provide full cycle service to foster local children’s ability to think critically, to strengthen their logic skills, and to help them fulfill their goals through innovative teaching techniques. We believe Love and Technology can make education better. Each week, more than 6 million students are enrolled in TAL's online and offline education platform.

Your Role:

Think Academy U.S. is seeking an enthusiastic Remote PreK to K Math Teacher to work with students from Preschool to Kindergarten in math. Teachers will be expected to thoroughly understand math concepts, prepare lessons based on Think Academy's curriculum, deliver engaging and age-appropriate math classes, and communicate regularly with students and parents.

As a Remote Math Teacher, your responsibilities include:

Preparing and teaching online math classes for students on a weekly basis (10-20 classes = approximately 10-20 hours/week)

  • Class assignments and teaching hours depend on your lesson preparation readiness and student satisfaction.
  • Participating in paid teaching assistant work by attending classes and learning from experience lead teachers' teaching methods.
  • Conducting trial lesson with new students to help them enroll in the correct classes (5-10 hours/week).
  • Grading homework and communicating with parents weekly to update them on students' learning progress and areas for improvement (3-5 hours/week).
  • Other work assigned by teaching management team.

Work Schedule:

About 2:00pm-8:00pm Thursday to Sunday (Weekend required)

    • Flexible for non-teaching hours, class schedules are our priority!

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher; all majors are welcome though Education or STEM-related majors are preferred!
  • Prior math teaching experience is a plus.
  • High-energy, enthusiastic, and charismatic with the ability to engage and excite children effectively!
  • Availability and willingness to work from Thursday to Sunday starting October 2026.
  • Passionate about teaching, responsible, and enthusiastic about working with children.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially with parents.
  • A stable computer, reliable internet and timely communication.

Pay & Benefits:

  • Competitive Pay:
    • Teaching Hours: $35/hr
    • Administrative Hours (Lesson Prep, Grading, Parent Communication): $16-$22/hr
  • Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere that suits you best!
  • Professional Growth:
    • Teachers who consistently deliver high-quality classes may be promoted to management roles, which come with increase responsibilities, additional performance bonuses, and enhanced benefits.
  • Paid Training Program:
    • Leverage Think Academy's paid, Teacher Training Program to develop your career in education!

Think Academy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: Embedded & Desktop Linux Systems Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world’s most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that’s challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Business Development Representative - West
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

This position is 100% remote and open to candidates based in the United States and Canada who reside in the Pacific Time Zone (PST/PDT).

GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing Sales team. As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted accounts working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.

Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams.

We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.

What you’ll do

  • Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory.
  • Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts.
  • Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
  • Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities.
  • Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies.
  • Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates.
  • Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast.
  • Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
  • Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.

What you’ll bring

  • Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.
  • Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.
  • Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.
  • Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.
  • Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.
  • Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.
  • The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.
  • Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.

About the team

As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.

Remote-Global

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. title: Business Development Representative, Financial Services
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

This position is 100% remote and will be based in the US and Canada.

GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing Sales team. As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted accounts working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.

Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams.

We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.

What you’ll do

  • Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory.
  • Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts.
  • Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
  • Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities.
  • Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies.
  • Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates.
  • Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast.
  • Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
  • Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.

What you’ll bring

  • Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.
  • Experience selling into or supporting the Financial Services (FINS) industry is preferred.
  • Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.
  • Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.
  • Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.
  • Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.
  • Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.
  • The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.
  • Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.

About the team

As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.

Remote-Global

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

$74,200—$84,000 USD

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. title: Sr. Scrum Master
description:
Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F) provides market leading property & casualty, accident & health, specialty and standard commercial lines insurance solutions. A true underwriting company, we have a 200-year history of helping our customers manage risk with laser-focused expertise, integrity and discipline. Our people are empowered to make decisions and problem-solve with you smartly and swiftly. Our annual gross written premium is 6.2 billion. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best.

Our most valuable asset is our people. We have 3000 employees, and locations throughout the United States and India. With our employee-first focus, the Company is consistently recognized as a great place to work, earning multiple workplace and wellness awards, including the Great Place to Work® Award, Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For, Fortune Best Workplaces for Parents, Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, and many others.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings. For more information about C&F, please visit our website: www.cfins.com

Our Surplus & Specialty Lines (S&S) Division develops customized coverage solutions for complex exposures, difficult-to-insure risks and niche segments of the market. S&S has over 850 employees (including more than 250 based in India), 10+ locations in the United States and 2 locations in India. Our product reach includes Sharing Economy, Environmental, Energy, Transportation, Construction, Excess & Umbrella, Primary Special Risk, Security, and other industry segments. S&S is the second largest division within C&F at over $1.5 billion in annual gross written premium.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Scrum Master to guide cross-functional Agile teams in delivering high-quality technology and business solutions. You will serve as a servant-leader, coach, and facilitator — keeping teams aligned, unblocked, and continuously improving across multiple concurrent deliveries.

What you will do:

  • Lead Agile execution using Scrum principles, ensuring effective ceremonies and continuous delivery improvement
  • Support multiple Scrum teams simultaneously on Agile best practices
  • Drive project delivery through effective planning, resource coordination and execution within scope and timelines
  • Identify and resolve team conflicts, impediments that block team progress and risks
  • Track and communicate sprint metrics, velocity, and delivery status to stakeholders
  • Foster a culture of accountability, feedback, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Partner with Product Owners and business leaders to align sprint goals with strategic priorities
  • Manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and coordination in a scaled Agile environment
  • Promote safe, engaged and high performing team environments

What you will bring to C&F:

  • 4-6+ years of hands-on Scrum Master experience in an Agile delivery environment
  • Bachelor's degree, or working equivelent
  • Experience working with insurance or financial services is required
  • Proven ability to manage multiple Scrum teams concurrently
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and leadership skills
  • Scrum Master Certification
  • Proficiency in Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence
  • SAFe certification (SAFe SM or SAFe Agilist)

What C&F will bring to you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness, including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenet is supporting your career development, so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, which may include tuition reimbursement, industry-related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee-driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community

At C&F you will BELONG

If you require special accommodations, please let us know. We value inclusivity and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you require special accommodations, please let us know. Belonging at C&F, is a mindset. It’s about fostering a culture of inclusion and connection, where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive and where our social impact efforts help strengthen the communities where we live and work.

For California Residents Only: Information collected and processed as part of your career profile and any job applications you choose to submit are subject to our privacy notices and policies, visit for more information.

Crum & Forster is committed to ensuring a workplace free from discriminatory pay disparities and complying with applicable pay equity laws. Salary ranges are available for all positions at this location, taking into account roles with a comparable level of responsibility and impact in the relevant labor market and these salary ranges are regularly reviewed and adjusted in accordance with prevailing market conditions. The annualized base pay for the advertised position, located in the specified area, ranges from a minimum of $91,400 to a maximum of $140,800. The actual compensation is determined by various factors, including but not limited to the market pay for the jobs at each level, the responsibilities and skills required for each job, and the employee’s contribution (performance) in that role. To be considered within market range, a salary is at or above the minimum of the range. You may also have the opportunity to participate in discretionary equity (stock) based compensation and/or performance-based variable pay programs.

description:
deine aufgaben:

Du entwickelst die Marketing-Website von chargecloud. Unsere Website macht das chargecloud Operating System, unsere Lösungen und unsere Expertise für Charging Heroes in ganz Europa erlebbar. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Online-Marketing-Team und unserer Design-Agentur zusammen. Du bist allein für die Entwicklung der Website verantwortlich: Dabei trägst Du die Verantwortung dafür von der Umsetzung bis zum Release.

  • Du entwickelst und veröffentlichst Landingpages, Kampagnenseiten und wiederverwendbare Module in React und Next.js auf Basis freigegebener UX/UI-Designs, damit das Marketing zügig veröffentlichen kann.
  • Du verbindest Storyblok mit unserem Next.js-Frontend: Dafür entwickelst du passende Komponenten, Content-Strukturen und Felder und stellst sicher, dass Inhalte flexibel und ohne deine Unterstützung zuverlässig ausgespielt werden.
  • Du setzt UX/UI-Designs in responsive, barrierefreie Seiten um, die über verschiedene Bildschirmgrößen, Zustände, Interaktionen und Sprachversionen hinweg funktionieren.
  • Du bindest die Website an APIs und externe Services wie HubSpot an und hast Performance und technische SEO im Blick.
  • Du priorisierst und planst deine Arbeit gemeinsam mit dem Marketing-Team und der Agentur, gibst realistische Schätzungen ab und meldest Risiken frühzeitig.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass die Website stabil bleibt: durch Tests, Code Reviews, Releases, Dokumentation und laufende Verbesserungen der bestehenden Architektur.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools dort, wo sie Zeit in Entwicklung, Tests und Dokumentation sparen.

das bist du:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation.
  • Berufliche Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Marketing-Websites und Landingpages und bist sicher im Umgang mit JavaScript/TypeScript, React und Next.js.
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Storyblok oder einem vergleichbaren Headless CMS (Contentful, Sanity, Strapi...) und der technischen Umsetzung von Komponenten, Content-Strukturen und Feldern; Kenntnisse in Node.js, npm und API-Anbindungen.
  • Du übersetzt UX/UI-Designs in responsive, wartbare und wiederverwendbare Frontends und achtest dabei auf Performance, Accessibility und technische SEO.
  • Du arbeitest mit Git/GitHub, Pull Requests sowie strukturierten Test- und Release-Prozessen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und organisierst dein eigenes Backlog strukturiert und pragmatisch. Du kommunizierst proaktiv und erklärst technische Themen verständlich, in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing-Team und Agenturen. Da du die Website allein betreust, dokumentierst du deine Entscheidungen.
  • Fließendes Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

das bieten wir:

  • Remote First: Ob Homeoffice, deutschlandweite co-working Spaces oder moderne Zentrale in Köln – wir decken alle Arbeitsformen ab.
  • Gut ausgestattet: Damit es dir im Homeoffice an nichts fehlt, stellen wir die passende Hardware zur Verfügung. Nach der Probezeit erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für ergonomisches Arbeiten von zu Hause.
  • Flexibilität: Bei uns kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten: Mit einer Kernarbeitszeit von 9:00 bis 12:00 Uhr hast du Freiraum, um Beruf und Privatleben entspannt zu vereinen. Mit unserem Workation Worldwide Programm kannst du bis zu 60 Arbeitstage im Jahr ortsunabhängig arbeiten – jetzt weltweit innerhalb von ±4 Stunden zur deutschen Zeitzone.
  • Benefits à la carte: Mit Probonio gestaltest du deine Benefits jeden Monat neu: Nutze dein Budget für Essenszuschüsse, Kita-Zuschüsse, Gutscheine oder buche dein Urban Sports Club Abo – ganz flexibel per App.
  • Mobilität & Nachhaltigkeit: Über FINN JobAuto kannst du dein eigenes E-Fahrzeug zu attraktiven Konditionen leasen. Zusätzlich profitierst du von Bikeleasing.
  • Teamgeist: Unsere Teams treffen sich einmal im Tertial persönlich zu Brainstorming, Workshops und natürlich zu unseren beliebten Sommer- und Winterfeiern.
  • Gesund im Job: Wir unterstützen dich mit Urban Sports Club, Life Coaching Programmen und weiteren Angeboten, damit du fit und stressfrei durch den Arbeitsalltag kommst.
  • Dog-Friendly Headquarters:Dein vierbeiniger Freund ist im Büro herzlich willkommen -- bring deinen Hund einfach mit zur Arbeit!
  • Und noch mehr: 20 % Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Zugang zu unserem attraktiven Rabattportal und viel Spaß(!) - "Spark joy together" ist nicht umsonst eine unserer Firmenwerte.

Teilzeit mit ca. 20 Stunden, unbefristet

lust teil des teams zu werden?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Alle Menschen sind bei uns willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht / geschlechtlicher Identität, Behinderung / Beeinträchtigung, Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion / Weltanschauung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung. Hauptsache, du passt zu uns.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. title: PMO Coordinator
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You’re the reason the PMO’s reporting rhythm runs on time, every time, so no function lead is left scrambling for a last-minute slide the night before a gate review. You bring cost, schedule and risk inputs together into one clear, decision-ready picture for leadership, and you chase the gaps early, before they turn into someone else’s problem in the room.

You’re also the fabric of the PMO. This goes well beyond reporting: you’ll help us make sense of the data we collect, creating unexpected insights, pointing out unseen opportunities and uncovering hidden dependencies. You’ll bring fresh ideas on how we work and challenge how things have always been done, and your insights will shape the decisions that move Alpha forward.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the PMO's reporting cadence, pulling together inputs from the Cost Controller, Programme Schedule Manager and Risk & Change Manager into steering committee packs and gate-readiness reports

  • Chase status updates ahead of gate reviews and leadership meetings, flagging anything missing, out of date or inconsistent before it reaches a decision forum

  • Maintain the reporting templates and dashboards (in Wrike or similar) that give leadership a clear view of milestones and status

  • Keep the master calendar of programme deliverables, gates and milestones across Alpha and Stellaris up to date

  • Support the logistics for PMO governance forums, including the Release Gates Authority and steering committees, from scheduling to papers

  • Help with ad hoc analysis of cost, schedule and risk data to support PMO decisions

WHO YOU ARE

  • You've supported a PMO or project controls function on a complex, multi-discipline programme, and you know what it takes to keep many moving parts in view

  • You're highly organised and good at turning input from engineers, suppliers and commercial teams into reporting that's clear, concise and actually gets read

  • You're confident with project management and reporting tools, and you pick up new ones quickly

  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus

  • You enjoy building things that don't exist yet and are comfortable with the pace and ambiguity that comes with it

  • You get real satisfaction from being the connective tissue of a programme: making progress, risks and dependencies visible so the people making decisions can make good ones

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (60 min)

  • Technical Panel (2x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: People Ops (HR & Recruitment) - Intern
description:
ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world’s biggest sports organizations. We work with 350+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including NBA and NFL teams, Premier League, LaLiga and Ligue 1 clubs, leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA, the Tour de France, and the Australian Open – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, produce and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 65-person team based between New York, Paris, and 10+ other countries, growing 2x year over year with 97% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

💡 Overview

As our People Ops Intern, you'll work at the heart of the People team, supporting both People Operations and Talent Acquisition. You'll own real projects end to end, be trusted to bring your own ideas, and see how a fast-scaling international startup actually runs behind the scenes, across HR admin, office life, employer brand, tech events and AI automation.

🧠 What you'll work on:

People Operations & HR admin

  • Support the day-to-day of an international team across France, the US, remote Europe, as well as parts of Asia and Australia: employment contracts, policies, employee benefits, onboarding and offboarding logistics.

  • Become our go-to expert on Deel (our global HR platform): research country-specific rules, maintain workflows and chase down answers.

  • Help handle individual employee cases that require research - dig into policies, employment contracts or local labour law and summarise what you find into something actionable.

Office, community & culture

  • Take ownership of our Paris office: visitors, room bookings, day-to-day logistics.

  • Manage tech equipment and assets: ordering laptops, tracking inventory, and keeping our internal records aligned with our compliance requirements.

  • Plan initiatives that make the office a place people enjoy: events, community moments, small things that build culture.

AI & automation

  • Audit our recurring admin processes, identify what can be automated, and build the automations yourself with Claude.

  • Elevate the role over time: the goal is that the manual work you do in month one no longer exists by month six.

  • Experiment freely. We'd rather you try ten things and ship five than wait for instructions.

Talent Acquisition & employer brand

  • Help organize tech events in Paris

  • Push the referral policy

  • Support employer brand content and research alongside our Talent acquisition lead.

  • Help with sourcing research when we open new roles or new markets: mapping companies, building talent pools, filtering candidates.

🧩 What we're looking for:

  • 6 months availability, starting January to March 2027

  • Based in Paris, fully comfortable working in English.

  • Thorough and reliable - you follow up, you don't let things slip, and the details matter to you.

  • Autonomous and adaptable. You'll juggle very different topics in the same day and figure things out without a manual.

  • Curious about AI, or already experimenting with it. No technical background needed, but genuine appetite to learn is a must.

  • You bring ideas. We're a small team and good suggestions get implemented fast, whoever they come from.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

Compensation: €1.5K per month

Our Mission

Prose is truly custom hair and skin care made-to-order—just for you. Our line of custom products are made by an in-house, Paris-based R&D team of gifted chemists who combine natural ingredients in innovative ways alongside dermatologists, giving consumers clean skin care, hair care and impeccable results.

At the heart of Prose’s success is Singular, its proprietary AI-powered beauty-tech platform, which has revolutionized personalized beauty at scale. Marrying a technology-driven approach with an apothecary-style concept, all Prose hair and skin care products are personalized to your one-of-a-kind hair, skin, goals and environment.

We’re a company that wants to change beauty practices, so we’re changing the way beauty companies practice. As a certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation and Climate Neutral, we’re proving that good business is always sustainable. With Prose, there’s nothing sacrificed to bring you great products—not trees, materials, wages, or performance.

Prose & Singular in Numbers

  • Founded in 2017, with hubs in Paris, New York, and Los Angeles

  • 10M+ consultations completed

  • 2M customers and 350K active subscribers

  • 21M custom products made, with 1M+ unique formulas

  • 350+ team members across disciplines

  • $600M+ in lifetime sales, with $165M+ revenue in 2024

Discover our Company Culture on Welcome to the Jungle here

Discover our Company Mission & Vision in video here

Prose, c’est une start up de beauty tech “born in Paris, made in New York” qui révolutionne l’industrie cosmétique. Chez Prose, nous créons des produits de beauté sur-mesure, totalement personnalisés : nos clients remplissent une consultation en ligne, puis nos algorithmes se basent sur ces données pour créer une formule unique à chacun, que nous fabriquons puis livrons depuis notre usine à Brooklyn : https://prose.com/ 

Nous recherchons un(e) Assistant(e) Chef de Produit pour rejoindre notre équipe Innovation & Brand Marketing et nous aider à développer notre portefeuille de produits. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les Chefs de Produit et contribuerez au suivi de l'ensemble du processus de développement produit, ainsi qu'à la stratégie d'activation 360° en collaboration avec d'autres départements (R&D, Data Science, Social, Growth, Ops, etc.) pour assurer la forte croissance de la marque.

 

Missions :

  • Réalisation d’études ad hoc et actualisation de l’étude de la concurrence et du marché (veille concurrentielle, positionnements prix, tendances, claims…) pour nourrir les concepts et contribuer aux lancements

  • Aide à la préparation des lancements produits (formule, packaging…) en collaboration avec les différentes équipes internes et externes (laboratoire R&D à Paris, usine aux US...) pour assurer le succès des lancements et l'alignement avec la stratégie marketing

  • Organisation et pilotage des tests consommateurs des innovations futures

  • Contribution à la réalisation de campagnes marketing 360° et de supports de communication

 

Profil recherché :

  • Actuellement en formation supérieure Bac +5 (Ecole de Commerce, Université…), vous avez une première expérience en Marketing, idéalement dans l’univers cosmétique

  • Vous avez un esprit créatif et une sensibilité à l’univers des cosmétiques et du digital 

  • Vous disposez d’un sens de la rigueur, de l’organisation et de l’esprit d’équipe

  • Français et Anglais (écrit et oral) courants requis

  • Convention de stage obligatoire

Prose Values

Intentional Inclusivity

  • We know the best ideas come from open minds and willingness to listen. While our products cater to the individual, an invitation into our process is always open to our community.

  • We value our differences and diverse backgrounds by communicating openly, managing with transparency and striving to understand one another’s perspective. It’s a key ingredient to our innovation.

Connected Collaboration

  • We stay in a spirit of entrepreneurial collaboration: We do not have consensus at all times, but we trust one another to work toward our common goals. Our success is an expression and result of our progressive and gratifying teamwork.

Driven, Together

  • We recognize that in order to continue thinking one step ahead, we will need to try new things. We strive to provide an open environment that accepts this truth, making space for new ideas to emerge.

Humanity Always

  • We assume good intentions in every interaction, keeping ourselves accountable for the climate we create. We seek to understand our co-workers through this lens of conscious benevolence, authenticity and fellowship.

  • We operate with the intention of preserving resources, creating an environment we can all live in – for our business and the world. Sustainable care is essential to our ethos as an organization. We take a mindful approach to how we think about our people (employees) and our planet.

title: Technical Oversight - Post Closing
description:
About Pylon

America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.

Join us in building America’s mortgage rails.

About the Role

We are hiring a Technical Oversight - Post Closing to own loan delivery, purchase timelines, and post-closing issue resolution across our investor and whole-loan channels. This role is accountable for ensuring closed loans are delivered cleanly, purchased quickly, and resolved efficiently when issues arise.

You will serve as the primary owner of investor delivery and rebuttals, as well as the main point of contact for sellers whose loans we purchase and the investors we sell to. This is a hands-on role for someone who has independently managed suspense, negotiated rebuttals, and understands how post-closing execution directly impacts cash flow, credibility, and risk.

This role operates post-close, with full authority once loans fund, and plays a critical role in protecting capital and scaling delivery operations.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Ownership & Execution

  • Own end-to-end delivery of closed loans to investors and whole-loan purchasers, ensuring timely submission and purchase

  • Build and maintain investor-specific delivery checklists, eligibility gates, and suspense prevention controls

  • This role also owns the day-to-day execution and performance of offshore post-closing and delivery teams, ensuring work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with investor delivery standards.

  • Track and manage purchase timelines, days-to-cash, and aging inventory

Suspense, Rebuttals & Issue Resolution

  • Manage all investor suspense, rebuttals, and curative documentation through final purchase

  • Act as the primary escalation point for delivery disputes, exceptions, and delayed purchases

  • Partner with legal and compliance on complex delivery issues or investor challenges

Investor & Seller Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for investor delivery and post-purchase review teams

  • Manage communications with correspondent sellers whose loans we purchase, including suspense requests, rebuttals, and resolution timelines

  • Ensure external communications are accurate, timely, and aligned with contractual and delivery requirements

Reporting, SLAs & Continuous Improvement

  • Own reporting on delivery performance, including first-pass purchase rates, suspense rates, rebuttal cycles, and cash timing

  • Set and enforce post-closing delivery SLAs, holding internal teams accountable

  • Perform root-cause analysis on delivery issues and drive process improvements to reduce repeat defects

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of post-closing and investor delivery experience, with flexibility for candidates who demonstrate deep, multi-investor ownership

  • Proven experience independently managing delivery, suspense, and rebuttals across multiple investors

  • Prior role as an escalation point for delayed purchases, delivery disputes, or investor exceptions

  • Experience designing, improving, or rebuilding post-closing and delivery workflows

  • Strong working knowledge of LOS platforms and investor delivery portals

  • Ability to track, analyze, and report on delivery performance metrics and cash timing

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort engaging directly with investors and sellers

  • High attention to detail, strong judgment, and a bias toward ownership and accountability

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a checklist-only post-closing role

  • Not limited to document trailing or file indexing

  • Not a passive coordination position

  • This role owns outcomes: delivery quality, purchase timing, and issue resolution

Benefits

Ownership: Meaningful early-stage equity in Pylon
Healthcare: Top-tier medical, vision & dental with dependent support
401(k): Ability to save for your future
Flexible Time Off: Be on when you’re on and off when you’re off
Hardware Allowance: $2,000 to upgrade your workspace
Annual Off-sites: Fully paid team off-sites
At-cost Mortgages: Financing support for your next home

description:
