GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. An overview of this role

As a Customer Success Engineer, you'll help customers get real, measurable value from GitLab after the sale by providing technical product expertise and best practice guidance. You'll be part of the Customer Success Engineer team that delivers GitLab's On-Demand Success Tier through webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, and on-demand engagements.

This is a pooled model, so you won't be dedicated to a specific set of accounts. You'll collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, and Renewals Managers to support implementation, architecture, and use case adoption across GitLab's key workflows, including source code management, continuous integration and delivery, DevSecOps, and Agile Planning. You'll report to the Customer Success Engineer Team Manager. Your first-year outcomes will focus on building trusted advisor relationships, enabling successful customer implementations, and creating reusable workshops and technical content that helps customers adopt GitLab at scale.

What you'll do

  • Engage with customers through Zoom calls and email as a technical consultant during the post-sales journey, providing product, solution, and best practice guidance.
  • Partner with Customer Success Managers to provide in-depth guidance on GitLab use case implementation, including source code management, continuous integration, continuous delivery, DevSecOps, and Agile Planning.
  • Deliver practical, customer-specific enablement through webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, and on-demand engagements in a pooled support model that isn't dedicated to a single account.
  • Provide technical and architectural guidance that helps customers adopt GitLab capabilities and connect technical decisions to the outcomes they care about.
  • Align with Account Executives and Renewals Managers to share customer-facing subject matter expertise that supports customer business objectives.
  • Develop and deliver workshops, demos, and other reusable enablement content in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
  • Build and maintain specialty competency in one or more technologies aligned with GitLab's market focus through training, certification, and working examples for internal and customer use.
  • Contribute to customer-facing learning resources, including GitLab documentation, YouTube content, and enablement programs such as the Digital Journey.

What you'll bring

  • Fluency in English and Spanish. Trilingual candidates who speak English, Spanish, and Brazilian Portugese is a strong plus.
  • Located in the United States, Mexico, and Brazil.
  • Experience supporting one or more GitLab use cases, such as source code management, continuous integration, continuous delivery, DevSecOps, or Agile Planning, and enabling customers with practical, in-depth guidance.
  • Proficiency with DevSecOps tools or adjacent technical tooling, with the ability to translate tool capabilities into customer outcomes.
  • A technical background in software development or systems engineering, including comfort discussing architecture, workflows, and implementation tradeoffs.
  • The ability to communicate complex technical and organizational topics clearly in writing and live settings, including Zoom calls, workshops, and presentations.
  • Experience operating as a trusted technical advisor to customer and business stakeholders in a post-sales environment.
  • Strong time management and prioritization skills, including the ability to manage multiple customer engagements and cross-functional requests in a pooled model.
  • A continuous learning mindset, including maintaining specialty competency through training, certification, documentation, or reusable examples. We welcome transferable experience from related roles and backgrounds.

About the team

We're a globally distributed Customer Success Engineer team supporting customers in GitLab's On-Demand Success Tier. We collaborate asynchronously and stay aligned through clear documentation and shared enablement assets. We continuously improve our content and delivery based on what we learn from customer engagements.

title: Field Instructor
description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

As a Field Instructor, you’ll serve as the lead of a Mobile Training Team (MTT), delivering mission-critical training to warfighters across the U.S. and abroad. You’ll report to the Training Lead and act as the primary point of contact for your training deployments—owning classroom delivery, managing logistics, interfacing with customer stakeholders, and upholding the highest standards of professionalism, safety, and instructional clarity.

You will deliver comprehensive training through classroom instruction, hands-on exercises, and live flight instruction, ensuring students develop the technical knowledge, practical skills, and operational proficiency required for successful system employment. You will assess individual performance against standardized evaluation criteria, maintain professional engagement with military leaders and operational teams, and support unit-level training to enhance readiness and capability integration. Additionally, you will contribute to curriculum development, training equipment management, and the continuous refinement of instructional methods through field-informed feedback and operational lessons learned.

This role is remote and requires travel expectations of 50%.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead instructor and customer-facing point of contact for all assigned field training operations
  • Deliver classroom instruction using standardized Neros curriculum, ensuring engagement and comprehension across varying skill levels
  • Coach students through hands-on troubleshooting and system operation while adapting instruction to their skill level, mission needs, and field conditions
  • Manage pre- and post-course logistics, including scheduling, site setup, gear preparation, and customer coordination
  • Maintain detailed training records, rosters, sign-in sheets, and pass/fail assessments using defined grading criteria
  • Submit after-action reports, performance summaries, and feedback to the Training Lead
  • Identify trends or challenges in student performance and provide structured feedback to help refine future curriculum
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Mission Success, to ensure training aligns with operational realities and system capabilities
  • Provide end user feedback across internal departments to inform product development and drive continuous improvement
  • Maintain professionalism and instructional quality across both classroom and range environments

You should have the following

  • Prior military experience or experience working with the military (strongly preferred)
  • Experience teaching, coaching, or mentoring adults in technical or tactical environments (strongly preferred)
  • Possess a valid FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate or obtain certification within 45 days of hire
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and classroom leadership skills
  • Familiarity with FPV systems and UAS operations, including basic air and ground components
  • Confidence leading groups in both classroom and field environments, with the ability to adapt on the fly
  • Experience using flight simulators as part of training programs (preferred)
  • Working knowledge and experience with ATAK (preferred)
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills, including grading, reporting, and inventory tracking
  • A high level of composure and professionalism in fast-paced or austere conditions
  • Initiative and commitment to continuous professional development, with an emphasis on technical and tactical proficiency
  • A mission-first mindset, willingness to travel, and a strong sense of ownership over training outcomes

US Salary Range

$67,500 – $94,500 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Neros' total compensation package.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Contract Administration & Customer Support

title: Clinical Documentation Improvement Specialist - Remote
description:
About Us

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with Advanced Recovery Systems.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org(opens in new window) to learn more.

Short Description

  • Uses clinical expertise to review patient medical records and ensure that the documentation accurately reflects the patient’s diagnosis, treatments and severity of illness. This role bridges the gap between healthcare providers and coding professionals, ensuring that medical records are complete, compliant, and support proper reimbursement.
  • Concurrently review inpatient medical records for clear consistent, concise, legible and accurate documentation to reflect the patient’s severity of illness and intensity of services.
  • Generate and utilize queries to clarify physician documentation whenever there is conflicting, ambiguous or incomplete information in the medical record regarding any significant reportable condition or procedure.
  • Complete analysis of clinical information to identify gaps in clinical documentation. To “bridge the gap” utilize the physician advisor for clarification of clinical presentation.
  • Collaboratively work with HIM Leadership, Coders, Coding Quality Educators/Reviewers and peers to improve accuracy of final DRG.
  • Collaborate and provide educational support to physicians, nurses and ancillary staff to facilitate modifications of clinical documentation processes that promote documentation improvement.
  • Facilitates modifications to clinical documentation through concurrent interaction with physicians, nursing staff, other patient caregiver and Health Information coding staff to support that appropriate reimbursement and clinical severity is captured for the level of service rendered to all inpatients.
  • Provide clinical review of cases denied for medical necessity by auditing agencies. Using knowledge of medical necessity criteria assist physician advisor in collecting pertinent information to support an appeal.

Experience Required

3-5 years of experience required.

Education Requirements

  • High School/GED Required
  • Bachelor's Degree Required
  • Bachelor's of Science in Nursing preferred

License/Certification Requirements

  • Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist Certification preferred
  • Certified Documentation Improvement Practitioner preferred
  • Registered Nurse, any state, preferred

Special Requirements

Professional team player, able to communicate well with others on all levels required.

USD $34.00

Salary Max ($)

Job Title: Systems Analyst

Role Summary

The Systems Analyst provides expertise regarding systems development implementation, maintenance and support activities to a wide range of business and technical situations throughout the SBU / SSU support area. The Analyst is responsible for leading, planning, and analyzing complex business requirements and implementing technology enabled solutions to address multi-facetted business opportunities and challenges.

The incumbent is Accountable for executing conceptual frameworks, implementation strategies and plans for recommended changes within SBU / SSU support area. The Analyst proactively contributes toward the development of the Technology team's tactical plans in support of business initiatives and occasionally offers directional guidance to clients and other applicable audiences.

Key Accountabilities

1.Provides technical expertise and consulting services in the development and implementation of new bank delivery systems, in order to achieve and maintain a competitive edge. Mentors system developers. Conducts and delivers analysis that presents comprehensive views on business challenges. Recommends and develops application architecture for assigned business application.

2.Completes complex systems development assignments, with minimal supervision, within budget and to client expectations, as required, which may include but is not limited to the following:

oCodes or makes modifications to programmes according to detailed business requirements and specifications, including the execution of team and operability testing.

oProvides the required documentation including software unit test strategy, plan, matrix, scripts, execution completion report, software impact analysis, back-out and recovery procedures, technical implementation procedures, computer run sheet updates, system documentation, data dictionary updates and system user guide.

oConducts feasibility studies of multi-discipline business opportunities and challenges, assuming the responsibility for the development of business proposals.

3.Delivers products and functionality that fully meets business requirements, that may include but is not limited to the following:

oEnsures compliance with established policies, standards and methodologies, e.g., project planning, security etc.

oEnsures that no outages / problems are identified during user acceptance, operability and / or stress and performance testing or product implementation.

oParticipates in post-implementation reviews as required.

4.Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of current and the future direction of financial and computer industries, as required, which may include but is not limited to the following:

oProvides expertise in areas of speciality, e.g., become the specialist in one or more information technology disciplines, commensurate with the current state of technologies.

oForecasts future trends, anticipates problems and conditions (e.g., volumes, new developments, turnover, etc.).

oConducts highly complex evaluations for product releases, standalone products, etc.

5.Partners and collaborates with Solution Architects, Solution Designers and Application Developers as required, striving towards high success levels in implementation of solutions and ongoing support.

6.Contributes to the realization of complex solutions that capitalize on business and technology developments by monitoring industry-wide standards and the development of new vendor products for applicability to the organisation.

7.Participates in the development, maintenance and implementation of policies, standards and guidelines on all aspects of technology architecture within the Technology team.

Role Specifics – Cyber Risk

Responsible for the technical analysis, maintenance, optimization, and support of key cybersecurity and data protection platforms across the Cyber Risk Programs. The role includes:

Maintaining, configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting EOS ITPM, Rubrik M365 Backup, and Digital Crown Jewel protection.

Implementing system upgrades, resolving technical and connectivity issues, analyzing logs, and optimizing platform performance and security controls.

Supporting business analysts and project teams with technical expertise and operational troubleshooting.

Analyzing system requirements, technical capabilities, integration points, and design specifications for M365 Backup/Rubrik, Project OHM, SharePoint Data Governance scanning, and Advanced Server Protection.

Supporting requirements and design deliverables, documenting technical decisions, reporting on system health and security posture, and recommending improvements to strengthen security, segmentation, backup, and data protection capabilities.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.

description:
100% Remote | Independent Contractor | 35 - 40 USD/hour

Help shape the future of AI.

Artificial Intelligence is evolving rapidly, and high-quality data plays a key role in making it smarter. We're looking for detail-oriented individuals to contribute to exciting AI projects by reviewing and annotating video content.

This is your opportunity to get involved in the world of AI, gain hands-on experience, and contribute to technologies shaping the future.

No previous AI or robotics experience required!

What you'll do

  • Review and annotate short video clips, identifying objects, actions, and events.

  • Evaluate video clarity, quality, and camera angles.

  • Assess movements and interactions based on project guidelines.

  • Ensure annotations are accurate and consistent.

What we're looking for

  • Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking.

  • Good written English and ability to follow instructions.

  • Reliability and ability to work independently.

  • No previous AI, robotics, or annotation experience needed.

Why join?

  • Earn  35 - 40 USD/hour, depending on your country.

  • Work remotely from your location.

  • Gain hands-on experience supporting AI development.

  • Contribute to projects at the forefront of technology.

Get started

We currently have three projects open! Complete our certification process to demonstrate your skills and be considered for the opportunity that best matches your profile.

Your attention to detail could help shape what's next in AI!

This is an independent contractor opportunity. Project assignment and work availability are subject to certification results and project requirements.
